content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks nigeria

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-owned stack of tools that handle hosting, payments, delivery, and storage without relying on third-party platforms. For Nigerian creators, this means selling ebooks directly to customers using cryptocurrency payments verified on-chain. The system is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. This architecture bypasses the need for Stripe, PayPal, or any other centralized payment processor. It’s not a hack—it’s a permanent alternative built on open protocols and decentralized networks. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform can shut you down, freeze your account, or dictate your terms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack begins with a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. This site displays your ebook and integrates a payment button linked to NOWPayments. When a customer pays, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and sends a webhook to your backend. The backend, built on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, processes the webhook, stores the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and triggers file delivery. The ebook is stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and delivered instantly via a secure, expiring link. Every component is modular and replaceable. For example, if you prefer BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees, NOWPayments supports them. The system is designed for zero downtime and minimal maintenance. Once deployed, it runs autonomously without requiring your intervention. This is infrastructure—not a service.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in Nigeria and similar regions who sell ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products but cannot access Stripe, PayPal, or equivalent platforms. If you’ve ever had a payment rejected, a transaction blocked, or an account frozen, this stack is your solution. It’s also for creators who value data ownership and operational autonomy. With this infrastructure, you control every aspect of your commerce stack. There are no hidden fees, no revenue splits, and no platform lock-ins. It’s designed to withstand currency fluctuations, financial sanctions, and geopolitical instability. If you’re tired of workarounds and want a permanent, self-owned solution, this is your architecture.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure replaces dependency with ownership.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of five core components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process payments and trigger file delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase (a serverless PostgreSQL database) or Google Sheets for simplicity. Files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and delivered via secure, expiring links. Payments are processed by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. Each component is open, replaceable, and interoperable. For example, if you prefer a different payment processor, you can swap NOWPayments for another on-chain solution. The stack is designed for flexibility and longevity.

Start by choosing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH. This includes deployment of the full stack within 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing. If you prefer to build it yourself, purchase The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete documentation, source code, and scaling guides. Both options give you lifetime access to the infrastructure. Once deployed, upload your ebooks, set your prices, and start selling. The system handles payments, delivery, and order storage automatically. You retain full ownership of your data and code. No platform fees. No subscriptions. No gatekeepers. This is not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent shift to sovereign commerce infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes full deployment within 48 hours, with 5 products loaded and end-to-end testing. You don’t need technical skills to use it.
What cryptocurrencies are supported?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, BSC, Solana, and TRON. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON—under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. This is sovereign infrastructure—not a subscription. You own everything after deployment. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge.
Can I sell products other than ebooks?
Yes. The stack works for any digital product: courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, etc. The file delivery system supports all formats.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
The stack is modular. If NOWPayments fails, you can replace it with another on-chain payment processor. You own the code and deployment, so you’re never locked in.
